# Light / dark mode (`theme.mode`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Personalization · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** yes

Switches Windows and/or apps between light and dark mode.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | one of: `light`, `dark`, `toggle` | yes |  | light, dark, or toggle. |
| `target` | one of: `both`, `apps`, `system` | no | `both` | What to change: both, apps only, or system (taskbar, Start) only. |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: theme.mode
    mode: dark
```

## In profiles

When this action is part of a [profile](../../guide/profiles.md), the current value is saved before it runs and
restored when the profile is reverted. Two actions of this type change the same setting when their `target` is the same.
